documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with standalone revenue of INR247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR269.23 crores. Management highlighted robust export performance, particularly driven by U.S. automotive OEM orders, while noting challenges from raw material volatility and increased shipping costs. The company is expanding its existing capacity with a new line expected to start production by February or March 2027 and continues to evaluate potential international plant locations. Overall, the company expects revenue growth of 10% to 15% and stable margins over the coming years.

guidance.claim: Management expects top line growth between 10% to 15% for the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years. This is what we can say currently right now.

guidance.claim: The company expects sales growth and increased momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 15% growth in value for the coming years.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the increased momentum in export OEM supply is expected to continue in the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the footwear business experienced a degrowth in the last quarter due to drastically increased raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that India signing recent FTAs is a very positive move that will increase customer sentiments to procure from India.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase.

demand_outlook.claim: PU business demand remains muted and commercial settlements have not yet matured.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the Footwear business is not growing because of local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new line for expansion in its current premises with production expected to start by February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The new expansion line will provide an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management states that the capex for financial year 2026-2027 is around INR50 crores.
Management states that if a final call on putting up a new facility overseas happens, the capex in the next 2 years will be INR250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant in South India would take approximately two years to start after a final decision is made.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

margins_costs.claim: Management states that sustainable margins are expected to be 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Shipping costs increased by 4x during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices went up sharply, followed by a fall and subsequent rise, creating a very volatile situation.
margins_costs.quote: The prices went up very sharply, then there was a fall in prices of some raw materials. Then again, the prices went up again. So, it's been a very volatile situation.

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improved in the last quarter and contributed to margin enhancement.
margins_costs.quote: So, our OE, I told in the previous question also, our operating efficiency also improved. That is one reason.

margins_costs.claim: Imports normally account for nearly one-third of the total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity utilization is between 75% to 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management states that the company has received good OEM supply orders from the U.S.A.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sold in the year was 31 million meters, representing a volume growth of nearly 5%.
Auto OEM exports increased from INR 194 crores last year to INR 290 crores in the current year.
orders_capacity.quote: Auto exports for the current year INR 290 Cr., and last year it was INR 194 Cr.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted market volatility and uncertainties such as the West Asia war affecting business conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The PU plant is facing intense competition from China and underutilizing its capacity.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure. So, there are 2 options. Obviously, I've told in the past also that we are talking to top brands, but sampling is also been done, but no business has been confirmed so far.

risks_headwinds.claim: Paste PVC prices went up significantly and initially presented a short-term availability challenge in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the new expansion line in the current premises is scheduled to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management projects a top line growth between 10% to 15% for the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The newly ordered coating line by the end of this calendar year should be done with a 1 month plus or minus variation.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done. Maybe 1 month plus or minus.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects a 15% value growth outlook for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
